description: In Apache Tomcat 8.5.0 to 8.5.71 and 9.0.0-M1 to 9.0.53, a TLS handshake issue may cause the server to fail when certain parameters are used.
verification_method: Non-destructive: check the reported server version against the affected range.

description: AJP connector flaw (Ghostcat) allows reading arbitrary files and, in some cases, remote code execution.
verification_method: Non-destructive: check AJP connector exposure and version.

description: Partial PUT with an ignored path parameter and default servlet write enabled can allow deserialization and RCE on Apache Tomcat.
prerequisites: Default servlet write enabled and partial PUT support
verification_method: Non-destructive: confirm server version is within the affected range.

description: Off-by-one in nginx resolver when parsing DNS responses may lead to out-of-bounds write.
verification_method: Non-destructive: check reported version against the affected range.

description: A signal handler race condition in OpenSSH server allows unauthenticated RCE on glibc-based Linux systems.
verification_method: Non-destructive: confirm reported OpenSSH version is in the affected range.

description: OpenSSH before 7.7 allows user enumeration via malformed authentication requests.
verification_method: Non-destructive: confirm reported version is below 7.7.

description: The Jakarta multipart parser in Struts 2 mishandles Content-Type, allowing OGNL-based RCE (S2-045).
verification_method: Non-destructive: confirm reported Struts version is in the affected range.

description: Log4j2 JNDI lookup feature allows remote code execution via crafted log messages.
prerequisites: Application uses a vulnerable Log4j2 version
verification_method: Non-destructive: confirm reported Log4j2 version is in the affected range.
